title: Execute packed Scale24 per-row selector dual-codebook W4 candidate

fresh_attempt_namespace.execution_marker_creation_rule: Create atomically exactly once only after deterministic candidate A/B identity, lossless packed-Scale24 closure, exact fresh-V9 reproduction, 169/169 V9-relative non-regression, strict aggregate fresh-V9 SSE improvement, 8/8 construction-blind non-evaluator exactness, 312 legal Dynamic Scale32 events, and complete hash verification produce PREATTEMPT_READY.json.

implementation_objective: Implement an isolated V10 runner and scalable backend that preserve V9 four-bit indices, dual signed-Q4.4 codebooks, and exact Scale32 values while storing each legal row scale in three bytes and assigning one selector bit per output row and input block. Do not modify RTL, the live chat path, sealed evidence, or Manager-owned stage state.

required_constructor.v9_initial_state: Freshly reconstruct all 169 V9 tensors under the V10 namespace, losslessly pack every legal Scale32 record into significand-low, significand-high, exponent bytes, copy V9 payload and dual codebooks, repeat each V9 grouped selector onto all rows in that group, and prove byte-identical V9 BF16 reconstruction before V10 updates.
required_constructor.packed_scale24: exact three-byte storage of the low 24 meaningful Scale32 bits; decode restores a zero reserved high byte; malformed reserved, truncated, reordered, or non-round-tripping records fail closed
required_constructor.dual_codebook: two strictly increasing sixteen-entry signed-Q4.4 int8 banks per contiguous 128 input lanes
required_constructor.selector: one bit per output row and input block for every transformer Linear and lm_head
required_constructor.selector_packing: output-row-major then input-block-major, least-significant-bit first, each tensor aligned to 16 bytes, all padding bits zero
required_constructor.objective: exact unweighted BF16 source-space SSE for all 169 Linear tensors
required_constructor.determinism: independent candidate A/B payload, packed-scale, dual-codebook, selector, reconstruction, objective, iteration-trace, weight, and state manifests match byte-for-byte
required_constructor.model_gate: all 169 tensors exactly reproduce fresh V9 before updates, none regress after updates, and aggregate literal unweighted BF16 SSE is strictly below 2176.5828747795154

model_and_alias_policy.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load
model_and_alias_policy.split_operation: clone the complete embedding tensor into a detached non-trainable lm_head Parameter before construction and set only in-memory tie_word_embeddings false
model_and_alias_policy.embedding_preservation: original embedding object, storage, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 bytes remain unchanged
model_and_alias_policy.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linears plus separated lm_head

pre_attempt_artifact_set.preflight_failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt_contract.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt_contract.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt_contract.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt_contract.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

acceptance_check: A Fresh Reviewer returns done after reproducing either a sealed marker-free PREATTEMPT_NO_GO with zero attempts consumed or a sealed single authorized attempt, and verifies exact packed-Scale24 round trip and accounting, deterministic construction, fresh-V9 reproduction and model gate, 8/8 preflight quality, 312-event Dynamic Scale32 legality, and all bound hashes.
